mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description FROM department WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.sql: doc.id, doc.name, doc.gender, doc.department_id, dept.name AS department_name, doc.title, doc.introduction, doc.avatar_url, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM doctor_schedule_slot slot WHERE slot.doctor_id = doc.id AND slot.schedule_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 13 DAY) AND slot.status = 'OPEN' AND slot.remaining_capacity > 0 ) AS has_available_slots
mapper.select: SELECT FROM doctor doc INNER JOIN department dept ON dept.id = doc.department_id WHERE doc.id = #{id} AND doc.status = 1 AND dept.status = 1

SELECT id, schedule_date, session_type, session_name, start_time, end_time, total_capacity, remaining_capacity FROM doctor_schedule_slot WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND schedule_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY schedule_date ASC, start_time ASC, id ASC
